name: hyperframes
description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
one_liner: Lets you (or an AI) write a webpage-style layout with charts, text, and images, and turns it directly into a video — no video editing software required.
buyer: A marketing or data team that needs to turn reports, charts, or dashboards into shareable video clips regularly, without hiring a motion designer for each one.
business_use_cases: A SaaS company auto-generates a short 'your monthly stats' video for each customer from their dashboard data, boosting engagement.
A finance newsletter turns its weekly market charts into a narrated video summary automatically instead of manually building slides.
An AI agent building automated reports outputs a finished video recap instead of a static PDF, making updates more shareable on social media.

money_ideas.idea: Build a hosted 'data-to-video' API that companies plug into their dashboards to auto-generate branded recap videos.
Sell a template library of pre-built HTML video layouts (finance recap, product launch, weekly report) for non-technical users.

steal_this: This weekend, build a template that turns a Stripe or Google Analytics export into a 30-second narrated 'monthly recap' video, and offer it as an automated add-on to SaaS founders.
